research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Synkrino Biotherapeutics is engaged in developing methods for detecting, preventing, treating, controlling, or managing progressive neurodegenerative diseases, as described in Astrotactin1-based compositions and pharmaceutical formulations. Their approach involves administering antibodies to reduce or eliminate monocytes that abnormally express Astrotactin, or to block blood monocytes with abnormal expression, highlighting a focus on immune system-derived drug targets for neurodegenerative conditions.

overview_description.description:
Synkrino Biotherapeutics is a biotech platform that discovers and develops novel drug targets directly from the immune system of patients. The platform is providing monitoring for pediatric rheumatologists for life-threatening conditions. It is currently building a rapid, portable field test for the RNA virus 2019-nCoV/COVID-19, adapting its existing analytic protocols for community public health screening.

Synkrino Biotherapeutics' therapeutics use AI + Immunology Discovery Engine (AIDE Engine) which applies neural networks and machine learning to measure the immune tissue from patients to repeatably discover novel and biologically-valid drug targets, enabling healthcare providers to cure their patients and improve their lives.
